from flask import Flask, request, send_from_directory, safe_join
app = Flask(__name__)
ROOT = "/var/data"

@app.route("/dl")
def dl():
    name = request.args["name"]
    path = safe_join(ROOT, name)
    return send_from_directory(ROOT, name)
